question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-03-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00';

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25 (all their orders)?

FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE (
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-09-25') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 25
    AND strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) <= strftime('%m-%d', '2026-09-25')
) OR (
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-09-25') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 26
    AND strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) > strftime('%m-%d', '2026-09-25')
);

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-26 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.birth_date IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    -- Exactly 25 years old on 2026-09-26
    -- Born on 2001-09-26 (since 2026-09-26 - 25 years = 2001-09-26)
    c.birth_date = '2001-09-26'
    OR
    -- Handle leap year case: if born on 2001-02-29 (doesn't exist), but 2001 is not a leap year
    -- So only exact match on 2001-09-26 is needed
    -- More generally: the 25th anniversary of birth_date is on or before 2026-09-26
    -- and the 26th anniversary is after 2026-09-26
    -- For someone born on B, they turn 25 on the 25th anniversary of B
    -- So we need: date(B, '+25 years') <= '2026-09-26' AND date(B, '+26 years') > '2026-09-26'
    -- But SQLite date functions work with text dates
    strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date, '+25 years') <= '2026-09-26'
    AND strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date, '+26 years') > '2026-09-26'
  );

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed by customers who were exactly 25 years old at the time of the order?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 
    -- Calculate age at order date: exactly 25 completed years
    -- Age is 25 if the 25th anniversary of birth_date is <= order_date
    -- and the 26th anniversary is > order_date
    -- Using text comparison since dates are in YYYY-MM-DD format
    (
        -- 25th anniversary: birth_date + 25 years
        substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) + 25 || substr(c.birth_date, 5, 6)
    ) <= substr(o.date, 1, 10)
    AND
    (
        -- 26th anniversary: birth_date + 26 years  
        substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) + 26 || substr(c.birth_date, 5, 6)
    ) > substr(o.date, 1, 10);

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-12-01 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 
    -- Calculate age exactly 25 on 2026-12-01
    -- Someone is exactly 25 on 2026-12-01 if their 25th birthday is on or before 2026-12-01
    -- and their 26th birthday is after 2026-12-01
    -- This means: birth_date + 25 years <= 2026-12-01 < birth_date + 26 years
    -- In SQLite, we can use julianday for date arithmetic
    julianday('2026-12-01') - julianday(c.birth_date) >= 25 * 365.25
    AND julianday('2026-12-01') - julianday(c.birth_date) < 26 * 365.25
    -- More precise calculation using SQLite date functions
    AND (
        -- Check if 25th anniversary is on or before 2026-12-01
        strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date, '+25 years') <= '2026-12-01'
        AND
        -- Check if 26th anniversary is after 2026-12-01
        strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date, '+26 years') > '2026-12-01'
    );

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of product d only, for orders placed from 2026-09-01 00:00:00 to 2026-10-01 00:00:00 by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?

FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE p.product_id = 'd'
  AND o.date >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.date < '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
  AND (c.birth_date <= '2026-09-25' AND c.birth_date > '2001-09-25')
  AND (strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) <= '09-25' OR strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) > '09-25')
  AND (2026 - CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - 
       (CASE WHEN strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) > '09-25' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) = 25;
